steps.title: Define App Configuration
steps.description: Configure app meta data including App Name (NoteSphere) and Package Name (com.notesphere.app).

steps.title: Establish Schema and Logic definition
steps.description: Define API Schema indicating offline status and structure mapping.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Configure build.gradle file for compileSdkVersion, targetSdkVersion 34, and Java version 17.

steps.title: Create Application Manifest
steps.description: Establish permissions, application metadata, and declare MainActivity and EditNoteActivity in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Design Round Button Drawables
steps.description: Create shape XML drawables for rounded button styles and tags.

steps.title: Design Main Layout XML
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml with note filters, search input, list view, empty note states, and note addition FAB.

steps.title: Design Edit Layout XML
steps.description: Create activity_edit_note.xml to allow creating new notes and editing or deleting existing notes.

steps.title: Design List Item Row Layout XML
steps.description: Design custom layout representation of single note card containing title, category, body preview, and time.

steps.title: Implement Note Java Model
steps.description: Create Note.java model representation enabling JSON serialization and deserialization.

steps.title: Implement Storage Manager
steps.description: Establish NoteStorage.java processing SharedPreferences and JSON data logic locally.

steps.title: Implement Note Adaptor
steps.description: Write custom NoteAdapter.java bridging note models to the native visual list items efficiently.

steps.title: Write Main & Edit Activities logic
steps.description: Code MainActivity.java search filter dynamics and connect EditNoteActivity CRUD behaviors.

steps.title: Building NoteSphere
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to build the NoteSphere APK.
